Officer's narrative
Officer narrative: Pearland, Texas. Responding to a report of a low-speed head-on collision between two passenger
vehicles on a two-lane roadway. Driver 1 was operating the vehicle that sustained the most visible front-end damage
and reported neck pain consistent with whiplash. Driver 2 stated the vehicles made contact after a biref loss of lane
control by the other driver. A Passenger was seated in Driver 1's vehicle and was present during the collision. Officers
observed that the damage pattern is largely consistent with the reported impact. Scene photographs confirm the
positions of both vehicles and the areas of contact. No independent witnesses were located at the scene. Driver 1
identified the owner of the vehicle as the policyholder, and Driver 1 reported living in the same household. No prior
damage to either vehicle was observed or reported. The injury Driver 1 described is consistent with the type and force
of this collision. This report is submitted for review.
</page>
